precepts.text: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
precepts.point: The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt be turned into another man. You don't believe that you could become a whole different person; the scripture says you can.

note.label: The Bottle, the Battle, and the Bible

precepts.why:
A lot of us are not finding comfort in the scriptures because we lack faith. You don’t believe the Bible can transform you. You don’t believe it can turn you into another man, that you could become a whole different person. But 1 Samuel 10:6 says it: “And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.”

John 3:3 says the same thing to Nicodemus: “Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”

Being turned into another man is being born again. The brother who drank a whole fifth in one night, the one who says, I can’t put it down, it’s a part of me, is not stuck being that man. Except he be born again, turned into another man, he cannot see the kingdom. The bottle is the battle, and the Bible is how you are turned into another man and win it.

precepts.text: If so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive, and after death ye shall obtain mercy. We got to be transformed in the renewing of our minds.
precepts.point: The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt be turned into another man. You don't believe that you could become a whole different person; the scripture says you can.

note.label: The Bottle, the Battle, and the Bible

precepts.why:
1 Samuel 10:6 says you “shalt be turned into another man.” 2 Esdras 14:34 tells you what your part is in that turning.

“Therefore if so be that ye will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, ye shall be kept alive and after death ye shall obtain mercy.”

Subdue your own understanding and reform your heart. We have to be transformed in the renewing of our minds. Transformed.

That is what the brother with the addiction runs from. He comes to the table having drunk a whole fifth in one night and says he is not an alcoholic. Even the white man knows the first step of recovery is to admit it: you have to realize you need help, that you are sick. Has he watched the classes on alcohol the Bishops and Deacons go over all the time? No. Why not? Because he is running away from his issues, and you cannot run away from that thing. You have to subdue your own understanding, reform your heart, and let the word turn you into another man, and then you shall be kept alive and after death obtain mercy.

precepts.text: The spirit of the Lord comes upon thee and thou shalt be turned into another man. If the word is dealing with you but you still live the old man, the Lord says many stripes.
precepts.point: In all ages she enters holy souls and makes them friends of God and prophets. She cannot dwell in a body subject to sin, hypocrisy, covetousness, or hatred. When you move like that you start saying absurd things. A prophet's job is to raise up God's children, which is why he cannot walk in hypocrisy.

note.label: Much Is Given, Much Is Required

precepts.why:
Psalms 19 showed the law converting the soul, and once converted we are new. 1 Samuel 10:6 says the same thing: “And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.”

With the word of God you change into another man. That is what Wisdom of Solomon 7:27 means: “she maketh all things new.” Wisdom will make you new, so you can’t keep doing the same thing.

But if the word is dealing with you and you are still trying to live that old man, still letting that old man tell you what to do, still doing that same stuff, the Lord says, I am going to beat you with many stripes, because I gave you something and you weren’t listening. Much is given, much is required. And don’t think many stripes is a pow pow and that is it. Many in that day will say “Lord, Lord”, and he is going to say, I don’t know you.

precepts.text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes; that is what the Most High did for Saul.
precepts.point: When Saul had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart, and all those signs came to pass that day.

note.label: 1 Samuel 10: Saul Anointed Captain and Chosen King

precepts.why:
“A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh. And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.”

That is what the Most High did for Saul: “when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.”

Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

points: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy. And they shall prophesy. Meaning they were already prophesying. This is what they do.

note.label: The Building Blocks of Bitterness

points: And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man. How is it you went from going to a tailgate, going to the movies, going to dinner, going to a baseball or football game, going to take the train or the bus, to now being in purple with those same men? The Spirit of the Lord fell upon you. That is how that happened. You did not get an instruction manual on how to become a prophet, like these apologists trying to get our welcome home package, trying to figure out how to learn what we know. It does not come that way. That is not the way you obtain it. It must be through the Spirit of the Lord.

So think about this. You were going about your day to day. You thought you were just going to run to the store for something real quick. Now you are among those men prophesying with them. Never in a million years. Even I can speak for myself. Even when I was watching the videos, I did not even imagine myself holding post, reading, giving out flyers, let alone teaching. I know it had to be by the Spirit of the Lord. Because even when you are like, dang, I have got to get around these brothers, still the thought does not really enter your mind as far as, I am going to do what they are doing. If you had that thought, you are a special kind of brother. I am talking about initially, when you first see it, when you first hear it, your first thoughts are, I never knew this, or this is some good stuff, or how can I learn more? That is where you are. It is not, I am going to be that.
And shalt be turned into another man. All praises to the Most High God. All praises for being turned into another man. Or did you? That is the question.

note.label: The Building Blocks of Bitterness

points: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee. So God is with you.

note.label: The Building Blocks of Bitterness

points: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them. So what we read is that the Lord, through Samuel, is prophesying of what is going to happen. Now in verse 10 we are reading it actually happening.

note.label: The Building Blocks of Bitterness

points: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets. Now, everybody should be able to attest to this. All that knew you before you got around the company of prophets. Wait a minute, he is one of those guys in purple now. Wait a minute, you are with those Hebrew Israelites? You are one of them?

Then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? That is like your big mama, your uncle, your friends. What happened to you? You have been celebrating Christmas your entire life. You love Christmas. What has happened to my baby? Who tricked you? You grew up in the Pentecostal church. What is wrong with Pastor Cleophus? They are saying, what have you turned into? What is this? And if they are not having that discussion, if they are not giving you that vibe, standoffish, it is because you have not fully changed into another man. You are still in a changing process, which is okay, but you must fully change into another man.

Is Saul also among the prophets? A lot of the brothers are at camp, but you will get a message from an old friend. Hey, you are with those guys in purple, right? I saw you in a video, or somebody told me that you gave them a flyer. You will get those messages.

note.label: The Building Blocks of Bitterness

points: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? And who raised you?

Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets? Therefore it became a saying among the people. They started to ask among the people, among the family, among the friends. Is Saul also one of the prophets?

note.label: The Bold and the Bashful

points: Samuel gave Saul the signs: the two men by Rachel's sepulchre, the three men going up to God to Bethel who would give him two loaves of bread, and the company of prophets with a psaltery, a tabret, a pipe, and a harp. The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man. God is with thee. Brothers, God is with you; you have to believe that.

note.label: The Bold and the Bashful

points: And the instruction: thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do. That is the commandment. Let us see what King Saul does in his bashfulness.

note.label: The Bold and the Bashful

points: The last scripture: this is when you go from a bashful sinner to a righteous man. And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man. You are not going to be that bashful little boy in a man's body anymore.

note.label: The Bold and the Bashful

points: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee. Brothers and sisters, you have to believe that. Stop being bashful.

note.label: The Bold and the Bashful

points: The Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man. If we keep our carnal selves we will not sustain psychologically what they do to us; but if we keep the commandments and the faith in Christ, and are turned into another man, the spirit of Christ, then whatever we go through, we will endure it. This is our lot. This is why we have to keep the commandments and go with the Lord's doctrine we read in Proverbs 4:2, his laws, statutes and commandments.

Do not think we are not going through Jacob's trouble, that we are getting beamed up by the chariots. Sorry, it is not happening that way; we have to go through the suffering, as our forefathers went through it. That is the ticket for our salvation and our entrance into the kingdom.

note.label: 1 Samuel 10: Saul Anointed Captain and Chosen King

points: That is why the scriptures call the ones who despised him the children of Belial, the children of the devil: the haters.
